# Buildwise Media

> AI systems for owner-led businesses. Bob is your AI teammate. The Buildwise team stays responsible.

## About
We connect tools and build software so teams can see what is happening and get work done. We work from the business records and access that each client approves.

## Services
- Lead response and follow-up: keep inquiries, replies and callbacks together.
- Service management: keep the case, owner and customer update together; flag gaps for human review.
- Connected business data: bring chosen records from sales, jobs, customers and money into a shared view.
- Websites for people and AI: useful human pages, clear business facts for AI research, and agreed system connections.
- Meeting follow-up: pull tasks, owners and decisions from calls for the team to check.
- Content drafts: use a shared fact record to support drafts that people review before publishing.
- Company knowledge: answers based on approved documents, with sources and access controls.

We start with one clear job in a 90-day Pilot. Scope, fees, ownership, access and support are set in writing. Ninety days describes the first engagement, not a guaranteed result or completion date. The website examples use sample data; they do not send messages.
